title: Elastic weight consolidation for better bias inoculation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating models on symmetric counterfactual datasets (such as the FEVER symmetric dataset) where labels cannot be predicted from the claim alone, thereby testing if models inappropriately rely on claim-only artifact features rather than considering the paired evidence.

Evaluating models on Natural Language Inference (NLI) stress-test datasets containing procedurally generated instances that specifically target phenomena like antonym presence and numerical reasoning to expose model over-reliance on simple linguistic shortcuts.
